text:
[RCLI.5.2] **Diagnostic codes are stable, and renaming one is a breaking
change.** Editors and CI wrap a compiler and match codes against their own
surfaces, so a code is a published identifier rather than an internal label.

This is [STYL.2.8.7]'s discipline reaching the surface a tool consumes: a
code out of use stays allocated and is never reused, and a live code never
changes its name to mean the same thing.
